question: can a multi-split anchor (rank 24, 25 or 26) lose k = m+2 terms whose collapsed sum is a single rank-1 tensor, i.e. can a rank-22 scheme share 21 of its terms with the anchor?

instrument.test: isRankAtMostOne, exact integer O(729): a pivot identity on all 512 non-trivial three-axis entries plus a 2x2-minor test on the pivot slice
instrument.crossCheck: unfoldingRankAtMostOne, an independent Segre-identity formulation, compared row by row in control oracle-agreement
instrument.budget: none inside the test - no branch and bound, no truncation, no floating point; only the anchor enumeration is time-boxed and its unscreened part is reported
instrument.field: integer arithmetic, so a refutation holds over Q, Z and every F_p alike; it says nothing about R <= 22 in general

relation: at R = 23 + m terms, dropping k = m + 2 leaves 21 kept and needs j = 22 - 21 = 1 extra term

controls.name: base-exact
controls.detail: all three base families verify exact at rank 23, 0 mismatches

controls.name: anchor-exactness
controls.detail: 36 anchors exact, 0 bad, up to 26 terms

controls.name: j1-accepts-single-term
controls.detail: 69/69 single-term drop sums accepted as rank<=1 (planted positive)

controls.name: oracle-agreement
controls.detail: 3000/3000 deficits agree with the independent unfolding-rank oracle

layers.anchorSampling: every refinement of every factor of every term of the three bases, capped at 2400 per base by a fixed stride
a deterministic strided sample of 1200 anchors per base from the 11476-slot space; the space is NOT covered exhaustively and the gap is UNSCREENED, never refuted
a deterministic strided sample of 400 anchors per base from the 573800-slot space; the space is NOT covered exhaustively and the gap is UNSCREENED, never refuted

scope: this screens only rank-22 schemes that share 21 terms with an enumerated multi-split anchor; it does not bound rank 22
an UNSCREENED anchor layer is never a refutation and is reported as unscreened
no bound moves: 19 <= R <= 23 over Q/R stands untouched
verdictMeaning: rank(D) <= 1 is decided exactly per row, so refuted rows are refutations; a survivor row is carried to checker.verify() and only an exact 22-term scheme would be a witness
